title: The date becomes a trading mentor
scenario: Someone you met on a dating app near campus chats with you for weeks, then mentions a relative who trades crypto. They offer to help you make a small trade on a platform they use.

answers.A: Keep the relationship separate from investing and do not fund or connect a wallet based on their recommendation.
answers.B: Research the platform and discuss it with a financially knowledgeable person you trust before doing anything.
answers.C: Try a small amount first so you can judge whether the platform is real.

explanation: Romance-investment scams are designed to feel like personal advice, not a sales pitch. Small early wins can be part of the setup.
